notes.zh:
### v0.6.0

- 项目选择："打开本地文件夹"由网关弹出系统原生目录选择框（浏览器环境此前无法选本机路径），菜单精简为默认工作区 + 打开本地文件夹
- 窄视口布局：侧边栏常驻为图标栏而非隐藏，顶栏版本徽章自动隐藏避免与按钮重叠
- WebUI 微信式截图捕获与输入区选择器打磨

### v0.5.0

- 记忆系统升级：常驻画像、反思写入、溢出自清理
- Provider 并发限流重试加入抖动，避免齐步重试
- WebUI 截图捕获入口
notes.en:
### v0.6.0

- Project selection: "Open Local Folder" pops the system-native directory dialog via the gateway (browsers previously could not pick local paths); menu trimmed to default workspace + open local folder
- Narrow-viewport layout: sidebar stays as an icon rail instead of hiding; version badge hides automatically to avoid overlapping header buttons
- WeChat-style screenshot capture and composer selector polish

### v0.5.0

- Memory system upgrade: resident profile, reflection-on, overflow self-cleanup
- Provider rate-limit retries gain jitter to desynchronize concurrent retries
- WebUI screenshot capture entry
